weaknesses.title: SYS PUSH is bag newline join — not string concat
weaknesses.detail: Building trail pieces with SYS PUSH piece TAG inserts NL between tokens (|\nv1). Agents must SYS CAT/STRCAT for string plane. Easy false friend after bag training.

weaknesses.title: TIMESF integer-only — no fractional half/decay
weaknesses.detail: Cannot TIMESF weight 0.5 for canary half-step; agents SETF/DECF or scale by 0 then SETF. Integer domain only.
weaknesses.repro: no factor 0.5; half traffic needs non-TIMESF path

weaknesses.title: CATF promotes numeric field to string irreversibly
weaknesses.detail: Proof CATF retries "x" → field becomes string "0x"; TIMESF/INCF then soft-fail. Audit mistakes can poison counters.
weaknesses.repro: CATF t retries "x" then TIMESF fails string

weaknesses.title: No compound TIMESF+BOUNDF / scale-with-cap op

weaknesses.title: PRINT LAST after SYS CAT may show length-ish plate noise
weaknesses.detail: CAT works (EQS); PRINT LAST output can look numeric (LAST_N). Agents should prefer PRINT_JSON or GETF plates.
